description: This file defines functions and context managers for managing node metadata hooks within PyTorch's FX graph module, including adding and removing hooks for node creation.

classes.name: GraphModule
classes.description: A class representing a Torch FX graph module used for symbolic tracing and graph manipulation.

methods.name: _node_metadata_hook
methods.description: A hook function that adds metadata to FX nodes during graph creation, copying relevant attributes and setting default values.

methods.name: _set_node_metadata_hook
methods.description: A context manager that registers a hook function to be called after creating nodes in a GraphModule, and unregisters it afterward.
